records.title: Philips 3300 Fully Automatic Espresso Machine with Milk Frother
records.card_text: Philips 3300 Fully Automatic Espresso Machine with Milk Frother. Current Price: $729.95. Sur La Table & more. Free delivery. 30-day returns. Rated 4.2 out of 5. 385 reviews. Go to product viewer for this item.

responses.message: I recommend the Philips 3300 at $729.95, leaving $70.05 below your equipment limit. Its matched Sur La Table page identifies the LatteGo automatic milk system. Based on general knowledge of this fully automatic machine category, I expect integrated bean grinding and brewing, with built-in equivalents for manual espresso accessories. That makes it an approachable choice for two successive morning milk drinks. No separate grinder or frother should be needed. Expect routine milk-system cleaning, grounds disposal and descaling. The frozen facts do not enumerate accessories or electrical specifications; ordinary US household configuration is a reasonable assumption here. The card names “Sur La Table & more,” so its aggregate seller and return information is not a verified guarantee for every underlying offer.
